record.question: According to the United Nations World Economic Situation and Prospects (WESP) 2019, the global economy is expected to grow at a steady pace of around ________ per cent in 2019.
record.explanation: Answer D: 3. UN World Economic Situation and Prospects 2019 projected global growth of 3.0% for 2019 (and 3.0% in 2020). Reference: https://www.un.org/development/desa/dpad/publication/world-economic-situation-and-prospects-2019/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
